canDoYue: 你識退房：1208 房延遲到一點要四十蚊，冇攞迷你吧，行李存到四點牌號五十二，訂四點半機場的士，同埋要房費收據。
canDoEn: Check out of room twelve-oh-eight with a late checkout until one, store luggage until four under tag fifty-two, book a taxi for four thirty, and ask for the room receipt by email.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm checking out of room twelve-oh-eight. Could I get a late checkout until one?
dialogue.glossYue: 你好，我要退 1208 房。可唔可以延遲退房到一點？
dialogue.say: Hi, I'm checking out of room twelve-oh-eight. Could I get a late checkout until one?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Sure. A late checkout is forty dollars. Did you take anything from the minibar?
dialogue.glossYue: 可以。延遲退房四十蚊。你有冇攞迷你吧嘅嘢？
dialogue.say: Sure. A late checkout is forty dollars. Did you take anything from the minibar?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: No, nothing. My flight is at eight tonight. Can you store my luggage until four?
dialogue.glossYue: 冇。我今晚八點班機。可唔可以幫我存行李到四點？
dialogue.say: No, nothing. My flight is at eight tonight. Can you store my luggage until four?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Of course. Here's your tag number, fifty-two. Just show it when you come back.
dialogue.glossYue: 當然可以。你嘅行李牌號碼係五十二。返嚟出示就得。
dialogue.say: Of course. Here's your tag number, fifty-two. Just show it when you come back.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thanks. Could you book me a taxi to the airport for four thirty?
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。可唔可以幫我訂四點半去機場嘅的士？
dialogue.say: Thanks. Could you book me a taxi to the airport for four thirty?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: No problem. It's about three hundred dollars, and you pay the driver.
dialogue.glossYue: 冇問題。大約三百蚊，你直接畀錢司機。
dialogue.say: No problem. It's about three hundred dollars, and you pay the driver.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Great. Could you email me the receipt for the room?
dialogue.glossYue: 好。可唔可以將房費收據電郵畀我？
dialogue.say: Great. Could you email me the receipt for the room?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Sure, it's on its way. Have a safe flight!
dialogue.glossYue: 可以，已經寄出。一路順風！
dialogue.say: Sure, it's on its way. Have a safe flight!
